name: Ball Form of Ampleness
statement: For every nonempty proper $X\subsetneq Q_E$ and every field $k$, ampleness of $X$, constructible-ball structure of its Yang complex $\Delta_X$, and $k$-homology-ball structure of $\Delta_X$ are equivalent. The ball has dimension $|E|-1$ and boundary $\partial\Delta_X=\Delta_X\cap\Delta_{Q_E\setminus X}$. Moreover, $X$ is corner-peelable exactly when this ball is shellable.
proof: The ample--Cohen--Macaulay dictionary identifies ampleness with Cohen--Macaulayness of $\Delta_X$. A nonempty proper full-dimensional subcomplex of the cross-polytope boundary that is Cohen--Macaulay is a constructible triangulated ball; constructible balls are Cohen--Macaulay over every field, and homology balls are Cohen--Macaulay, giving all three equivalences. The complementary-ball theorem for polarizations identifies the complement Yang complex as the other ball and their intersection as the common boundary. The shelling--corner-peeling correspondence proves the final assertion.
